arbiter: Hand-derived half-open integer sets and exact linear longitudes; no astronomical output

angular.derivation: Ascendant is 0. Venus is 10-t and Jupiter is 20-t degrees modulo 360. Inclusive orb 5 admits Venus at integer labels 5 through 15 and Jupiter 15 through 25. Any is their union; all is their intersection.

applying.derivation: Moon is 50+t degrees, Sun is 60, Mercury is 65. Moon moves positively and targets are fixed. For conjunction orb 5 the Moon applies to Sun at integer labels 5 through 9, and Mercury 10 through 14. Exact contacts at 10 and 15 separate. Any is their union; all is empty.

houses.derivation: Canned native cells [0,4), [4,7), [7,10) assign Venus/Jupiter houses (1,2), (3,1), (1,1). The last cell is a whole-sign fallback from requested Placidus. Rejecting fallback leaves it unknown. Allowing it uses its declared membership.
